metadata.article: ARTICLE 4-4. ACCESS, CIRCULATION, MOBILITY, AND UTILITIES
metadata.division: DIVISION 4-4-1. PURPOSE AND APPLICATION OF ARTICLE

content.title: 4-4-1-1. Purpose of article.
content.summary: The purpose of this Article is to promote safe and efficient access to development and circulation within development, to provide for the efficient and hierarchical layout of streets, to provide for connections to transit services, and to ensure that development is served by appropriate utilities.
